reason: I forget pills at home all the time, and one foil sachet with the 2 capsules already counted fits in my bag. The doctor said my magnesium could be low, and a lab report I can check against the batch number makes me trust it more. At $24.99 for the first box I will try one.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put several forms in one capsule? Also I would be paying more for the sachet packaging than for the magnesium itself.
would_change_my_mind: A clear note from the lab report or the box card on why bisglycinate alone is enough, or a lower price per day than the shelf bottles I already see.
